en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a circular fountain with sculpted reliefs and water jets in the foreground, set in a park. Behind it stand the stone ruins of a 16th‑century structure, partially covered by trees. The reverse side has multilingual printed text identifying the site as the ruins of Tettye in Pécs, Hungary, with standard postcard address lines and publisher information.
